What the app is

Nabeeh is a personal budgeting tool: it works out your daily spending limit from your salary, commitments and goals, and reminds you of payout dates. It is published by Nibras Tech (independent developer).

Not financial advice

The figures are estimates based on what you enter. The app is not financial, investment, legal or banking advice, and we are not licensed to give it. Your financial decisions are your responsibility.

Payout dates

The salary and benefit payout dates shown are guidance that we collect and update by hand from public sources. They can change, arrive late or contain errors. They are not an official announcement by any body, and we do not represent any government or banking entity. Always check with the body concerned.

Your data

You are responsible for the accuracy of what you enter. Your data is stored on your device; losing the device, uninstalling the app or resetting the account deletes it and we cannot recover it. Use report export if you want a copy.

Nabeeh Plus

  • Price: SAR 9 per month or SAR 67 per year, including VAT.
  • A 7-day free trial for eligible subscribers; Google Play decides whether you are eligible.
  • The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period unless you cancel before the renewal date.
  • Billing and refunds are handled by Google Play under its policies. To cancel: Google Play → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions, or the “Manage subscription” button in the Upgrade tab.
  • After cancelling, Nabeeh Plus features remain until the end of the paid period.

Nabeeh Plus includes:

  • Unlimited savings goals (the free version holds 3 goals).
  • Export of the current cycle’s report as PDF and CSV.
  • Daily spending-limit alerts.
  • Ad removal.
